title: Working Student / Intern AI Product Associate (f/m/x)
description:
TL;DR — alago brings AI-powered project management to the construction industry. As our Product Associate, you'll help build our discovery engine: the system that turns customer pains into shipped features on autopilot. Working student, on-site in Munich.

About alago

Imagine if building a building were as easy as building software. Every moving part visible, every change traceable, every decision still carrying its reasoning six months later.

Software got there by making its own history legible — every commit, every diff. Construction never did. A €200M project runs on plan sets nobody can diff and decisions buried in email, so the same mistakes happen over and over — and the industry loses $1.6 trillion a year to it.

That's what we're fixing. Eleven people, 20+ customers, €1M+ pre-seed from leading construction-tech VCs and one of Germany's largest project developers.

Aufgaben

Product management is changing forever: continuous discovery, specs written for agents as much as engineers, customer pain to shipped feature in days. You get to learn it now, on a real product with real customers.

You'll help build our discovery engine, the workflows and AI agents that catch what customers complain about and turn it into prioritized product input, and you'll be the first person to run it. What we decide to build next comes out of what you surface.

This is a new kind of role, sitting at the intersection of product, engineering and customer success:

📋 Product Operations

  • Turn customer feedback into actionable product insights
  • Write the specs those insights become, precise enough that an engineer or an AI agent builds from them without a follow-up call
  • Improve and implement our discovery process — tools, workflows, standards

🤝 Customer Success

  • Support customer implementations and deployments
  • Create feature demo videos and customer tutorials
  • Talk to users about what's working and what isn't

You will be working closely with Vinzenz (CTO) and Ann (CPO).

After six months you'll have shipped features you can point to, specs you'd show as work samples, real fluency in Cursor and Claude Code on a production product, and a system that keeps running after you leave.

Qualifikation

This is the perfect role for a motivated student who wants to gain hands-on experience at an early-stage company and help shape the future of construction with applied AI. Whether you dream of founding your own company one day or see yourself growing with us long-term, you'll gain invaluable skills and make a real impact here.

  • German at C1+ — you'll handle customer conversations in German construction terminology
  • Enrolled in a master's program, available for 6+ months
  • You like writing. Specs, docs, release notes. Writing is thinking, not paperwork.
  • You think in systems: when something works, you make it repeatable
  • You'd rather ask a customer than guess what they meant

Bonus Points:

  • You’ve built or contributed to projects using Loveable, v0, Cursor or similar
  • You’ve participated in hackathons
  • Great UI/UX excites you

Benefits

As one of our first hires, you’ll do more than contribute — you’ll help shape how Alago works: our culture, systems, and growth strategy. You’ll work directly with the founders, gain exposure to every function, and ship projects that have immediate impact.

  • 🚀 10× Learning Curve. Work with cutting-edge AI to tackle real-world challenges every day
  • 💥You ship fast and own the outcome. You’ll design features that take the pain out of project management, automating away the repetitive tasks and overhead teams hate.
  • 🎯 Work directly with the founders. You’ll own critical parts of alago end-to-end, laying the technical foundation while balancing rapid iteration, customer value, and long-term scalability.
  • 🏠 A vibrant in-office culture in our central Munich office. We come together in our Munich office at least three days a week (two, if you are a working student). Beyond that, you’re welcome to work remotely for a few weeks at a time whenever your circumstances or preferences require it.
  • 💸 Competitive salary, so you are invested in our success

About the application process

1. Submit your story

  • Tell us about something you built that had real impact.

2. Intro Call (25min)

  • Intro, Logistics & Fit with a founder.

3. Product Challenge (45min)

  • Tackle a product challenge in person

4. Offer

  • We’ll get back to you within 24 hours. If it’s a fit — let’s go! 🎉

Alago is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: AI Transformation Working Student
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You work directly with our AI Transformation Catalyst at CHAPTERS Group, helping translate AI capabilities into real business value across 55+ portfolio companies. This is not a research or shadowing role. You take ownership of tasks, run your own analyses, document what works, and help shape how AI adoption spreads across the group. You work in a lean team, directly with senior stakeholders, and you are expected to contribute your own ideas.

What You Will Work On

  • Build AI Hub use cases for real problems in OpCos: custom models with the right knowledge, tools, and prompts, ready for Champions and their teams to use
  • Ship pilot use cases end to end: take an idea from a Champion, build it in the Hub, test it with the OpCo, and hand it over ready to use
  • Build enablement assets on the Hub: prompt libraries, knowledge bases, evaluation setups, and custom models that make it easier for new OpCos to get started
  • Scout emerging AI capabilities (models, agents, tools, integrations) and translate the useful ones into Hub configurations Champions can pick up
  • Research and document validated use cases in a structured format: problem, affected role, time saved, solution, and transferability across OpCos
  • Draft internal communications, playbooks, and best-practice guides that help Champions and OpCo managers get started quickly
  • Track adoption metrics across OpCos and prepare concise status updates for the AI Core team and leadership
  • Prepare materials for Champion onboarding, training workshops, and the monthly AI Champions League calls

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Currently enrolled in a Business, Economics, or related programme (Master's preferred)
  • AI native: you use AI tools daily as part of how you work, not as a novelty
  • Builder mindset with hands-on project experience: automations built in n8n, prototypes in Cursor or Lovable, or any project that shipped
  • Prior work experience through an internship, working student role, or your own venture, ideally in a startup or tech-adjacent environment
  • You translate technical AI capabilities into business language: you talk about time saved and cost avoided, not model architectures
  • Comfort with data: you can pull numbers from a spreadsheet, spot a trend, and explain what it means for a decision
  • Highly self-directed: you move forward with incomplete information, ask the right questions, and synthesize fast
  • Strong written communication in English (fluent) and German (fluent or native)

Bonus

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG concepts, or custom AI model configuration
  • Experience using Claude Code or Codex
  • Background or coursework in change management, organisational development, or innovation management
  • Experience working in or with B2B software companies or vertical SaaS environments

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • Direct daily collaboration with the AI Transformation Catalyst: real sparring, not task assignment from a distance
  • Exposure to a live enterprise AI rollout across 55+ companies: strategy, enablement, and the messy middle in between
  • Access to the full CHAPTERS AI Hub: Anthropic, OpenAI, custom models, knowledge bases, and the tools that power real AI workflows
  • A front-row seat at the intersection of AI and business transformation in the DACH software market
  • Real ownership: your own workstreams, not just supporting tasks, and your name on deliverables
  • A network across portfolio companies, platform teams, and the central AI Core team
  • Space to experiment and build: if you have a better way to do something, say so
  • A stepping stone: strong performance opens doors to full-time roles in the AI Core team or across the portfolio

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why does CHAPTERS' model, a portfolio of specialized B2B software companies, appeal to you specifically?
  • What's your unfair advantage for this role?

We are looking forward to your application!

description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . Job Summary As a Project Operations Specialist, you will be a key member of the Talent Screening team and the operational partner who ensures screening work moves seamlessly from request to execution. You will coordinate sourcing requests, maintain screening readiness, monitor operational performance, support cross-service talent movement, and help launch new screening initiatives. In this role, you will own the day-to-day execution of screening operations by coordinating stakeholders, tracking dependencies, maintaining accurate documentation, identifying risks early, and ensuring work is completed on time. You will work closely with the Screening Operations Manager, Sourcing teams, Screeners, Analytics, Product, and other cross-functional partners. This is an individual contributor role with meaningful end-to-end ownership. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, analytical, proactive, and excels at bringing clarity and structure to complex operational workflows. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. • Coordinate sourcing requests from intake through launch, ensuring all required information is complete and requests meet the 24-hour preparation standard. • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements, track dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure timely execution. • Maintain accurate operational trackers, documentation, decision logs, and process guidance. • Monitor screening readiness, capacity, funnel performance, and operational metrics, identifying risks and recommending improvements. • Escalate operational risks with clear context and recommended actions. • Support talent movement across services and acquired-company onboarding by coordinating screening requirements and stakeholder handoffs. • Coordinate screening path updates across operations, content, systems, and screeners to ensure successful implementation. • Perform data quality checks, investigate discrepancies, and maintain reliable operational reporting. • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for screening-related requests, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through. • Contribute to process improvements, documentation, and new screening initiatives that improve efficiency and scalability. In the first week, expect to: • Complete onboarding and become familiar with the Talent Screening team, systems, tools, and operational workflows. • Meet key stakeholders and gain an understanding of screening operations and business priorities. • Shadow sourcing request preparation, screening readiness reviews, and cross-functional processes. In the first month, expect to: • Build a solid understanding of the end-to-end screening process and operational workflows. • Begin managing sourcing requests and operational follow-ups with guidance from the Screening Operations Manager. • Develop effective working relationships with cross-functional partners. In the first three months, expect to: • Independently manage sourcing requests while maintaining the 24-hour preparation standard. • Monitor screening readiness, capacity, and operational health, proactively identifying risks and opportunities. • Recommend and implement improvements to workflows, documentation, or operational processes. In the first six months, expect to: • Own operational execution across your assigned scope with minimal oversight. • Support the launch and scaling of new screening initiatives and operational improvements, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. • Drive efficiencies by improving processes, documentation, and operational reporting. In the first year, expect to: • Become a trusted operational partner across the Talent Screening organization. • Help build scalable, transparent operational processes that support business growth. • Influence operational improvements through data-driven insights and cross-functional collaboration. • Be recognized for consistently delivering operational excellence, strong ownership, and reliable execution. Qualifications and Job Requirements: • Bachelor’s Degree is required. • 2-4+ years of experience in operations, talent operations, project coordination, program management, or a similar cross-functional environment. • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail. • Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify trends, solve problems, and improve processes. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate priorities, risks, and recommendations. • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets and operational tracking tools; experience with dashboards, workflow automation, or low-code/no-code tools is a plus. • Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset. • High level of ownership, accountability, and follow-through. • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with changing priorities. • Experience supporting talent screening, marketplace operations, or technology-enabled operations is preferred. • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
